proof_summary: Write \(m=\lfloor rn\rfloor\) and \(f=rn-m\); irrationality gives \(0<f<1\), and \(r^2=2r+\tfrac14\) gives \(rm=2m+\tfrac n4-(r-2)f\) with \(0<r-2<\tfrac14\). Splitting \(n\) modulo \(4\) evaluates the remaining floor and makes the error respectively \(1+2f,\ \tfrac14+2f,\ \tfrac12+2f,\ \tfrac34+2f\), from which the strict bounds follow.
